claim: the marathon-time goal is authored with verification=attested and no metric, target, dataset or session_type, even though 3:20 and then 3:15 are exact, well-defined numbers
truth: the numbers are real; they live only in the title and rationale text
expect: no engine behaviour is asked of this row beyond holding it as the athlete's stated aim (class a)
gap: contributions.py's own contribution model only accumulates a metric across a period (MONOTONIC: more always counts; GUARDED: a ramp ceiling) - it has no goal KIND for a single-event performance threshold. Had this goal been authored as measured with metric=duration_s, every training run's duration would sum into the same bucket as a marathon finish time, which is meaningless; contributions.py names the missing piece itself, as 'goal KINDS of G62 (quantity | skill | maintenance)' - a threshold/skill goal needs its own contribution model, distinct from the volume accumulator this file implements today
